description: The brain and its context builder: representation-service (builds the SHARED TRANSACTION REPRESENTATION from Neo4j + Redis + payload) and commerce-orchestrator (FastAPI + LangGraph StateGraph that drives the whole evaluation and, with NO agents, still reaches a decision via the deadline/decide_partial missing-verdict path). Depends on FEAT-002 because the orchestrator calls ml-scoring is NOT needed directly, but it calls representation-service, decision-engine, and payment-processor-sim (all must exist). Depends on FEAT-001 for the topic map (fan_out publishes to TXN_EVALUATE, finalize to TXN_LIFECYCLE; collect_verdicts consumes AGENT_VERDICTS) and config URLs. Both services follow the standard skeleton (Dockerfile python:3.11-slim non-root, uv workspace member, FastAPI /healthz+/readyz, Settings config, structured logging + trace_id).
steps: representation-service (docs/03 §8, docs/01 §4 step 2): services/representation-service/ with src/representation_service/{__init__.py,main.py,builder.py,stores.py} and tests/test_builder.py. POST /v1/representation takes the transaction core (amount, currency, method_type, merchant_id, customer_id) + transaction_id + trace_id. stores.py hydrates graph signals from Neo4j (ring_size via the FROM_DEVICE device-sharing traversal pattern in docs/03 §3; customer_txn_count_30d; customer_chargeback_count; per-method USED_METHOD_TYPE successes/failures; candidate Processor routes) and hot features from Redis (velocity_1h etc). builder.py assembles the raw signal mapping, calls acip_common.features.build_feature_row to compute the 7 FEATURE_COLUMNS, and returns a SharedRepresentation (representation_version from Settings, built_at now, transaction=TransactionCore, features, graph_signals, method_history={method: MethodHistoryEntry}, candidate_routes=[CandidateRoute]). Cache the built representation in Redis keyed by transaction_id (docs/03 §8). SPARSE-GRAPH FALLBACK: if Neo4j/Redis are empty or unreachable, fill sensible defaults (zeros / a single default candidate route) so the path still runs; log degraded. /readyz tolerates store absence (up-but-degraded). Reuse build_feature_row, FEATURE_COLUMNS, SharedRepresentation, TransactionCore, CandidateRoute, MethodHistoryEntry, Settings. Pin deps neo4j==5.27.0 (matches root dev group) and a redis client (e.g. redis==5.2.1).

commerce-orchestrator (docs/02 §2.1, docs/01 §4, docs/06 §2/§4): services/commerce-orchestrator/ with src/commerce_orchestrator/{__init__.py,main.py,graph.py,nodes.py,clients.py,persistence.py} and tests/test_graph.py. graph.py builds a LangGraph StateGraph with a typed state (transaction_id, trace_id, representation, verdicts, decision, processor_result) and nodes from nodes.py: build_representation (clients call to REPRESENTATION_URL /v1/representation) -> fan_out (publish txn.evaluate.requested EventEnvelope to TXN_EVALUATE via acip_common.kafka.EventProducer, payload TxnEvaluateRequestedPayload with representation + expected_agents=all six AgentName + deadline_ms=Settings.decision_deadline_ms) -> collect_verdicts (consume AGENT_VERDICTS via EventConsumer, filter by transaction_id, accumulate until all expected arrive OR DECISION_DEADLINE_MS elapses) with a CONDITIONAL EDGE all_received->decide vs deadline->decide_partial -> decide/decide_partial (POST DECISION_ENGINE_URL /v1/decide with collected verdicts; decide_partial passes the partial/empty set so the engine applies the missing-verdict policy) -> execute (on APPROVE/ROUTE POST PAYMENT_PROCESSOR_URL /v1/charge; else short-circuit) -> finalize (publish terminal txn.executed/declined/challenged EventEnvelope to TXN_LIFECYCLE and persist the decision trace via persistence.py). persistence.py writes Postgres rows (transactions, decisions, agent_verdicts - tables already defined in scripts/seed.py) using psycopg; upsert by key (idempotent). Checkpoint LangGraph state in Redis keyed by transaction_id for crash-resume (use the LangGraph checkpointer interface backed by Redis, or a minimal Redis-backed saver if the official package is unavailable - justify the choice in a docstring). PHASE 2 CRITICAL PATH: with no agents running, collect_verdicts WILL time out with zero verdicts -> conditional edge routes to decide_partial -> decision-engine applies MISSING_RISK_FRAUD_POLICY and returns a decision; log this clearly ('no verdicts received, deadline elapsed, applying missing-verdict policy'). Expose POST /internal/evaluate (docs/06 §2) that takes a transaction, runs the graph synchronously to completion, and returns the decision JSON (the sync trigger checkout-api uses).

clients.py wraps httpx calls to representation-service, decision-engine, and payment-processor-sim with timeouts; propagate trace_id. Reuse EventProducer, EventConsumer, topic_for/TXN_EVALUATE/TXN_LIFECYCLE/AGENT_VERDICTS, EventEnvelope, EventType, TxnEvaluateRequestedPayload, TxnTerminalPayload, SharedRepresentation, AgentName, DecisionHint, Settings, bind_trace_id. Pin deps langgraph (exact version), httpx, redis, psycopg[binary].
Register both services as uv workspace members with acip-common = { workspace = true }; non-root python:3.11-slim Dockerfiles via uv; GET /healthz + /readyz on each.

Tests: representation-service test_builder.py covers the sparse-graph fallback (mocked/absent stores) producing a valid SharedRepresentation with all 7 features, and the full-graph case. commerce-orchestrator test_graph.py covers the graph transitions with ALL external deps mocked, specifically asserting the zero-verdict deadline -> decide_partial -> decision path completes and produces a decision (the Phase 2 no-agents guarantee), plus the all_received->decide path.
acceptance_criteria: representation-service POST /v1/representation returns a SharedRepresentation with all 7 FEATURE_COLUMNS populated via build_feature_row, caches by transaction_id in Redis, and falls back to defaults when the graph is sparse/unreachable.

commerce-orchestrator exposes POST /internal/evaluate that runs the LangGraph graph (build_representation->fan_out->collect_verdicts->decide/decide_partial->execute->finalize) end to end and returns a decision.

With NO agents, collect_verdicts hits the deadline with zero verdicts, the conditional edge routes to decide_partial, and a decision is still produced and logged - proven by a unit test with mocked deps.

finalize persists transactions/decisions/agent_verdicts rows to Postgres (matching scripts/seed.py table shapes) and emits the terminal event on txn.lifecycle; orchestrator state is checkpointed in Redis.
Both services are uv workspace members with non-root python:3.11-slim Dockerfiles and GET /healthz + /readyz.
verification: uv run pytest services/representation-service services/commerce-orchestrator  (all pass, incl. the zero-verdict decide_partial transition and the sparse-graph fallback)
uv run ruff check services/representation-service services/commerce-orchestrator  (clean)
uv run mypy services/representation-service services/commerce-orchestrator  (clean, strict)
findings:
LANDED. Full gate green: uv sync --locked OK; uv run pytest libs/acip-common services = 66 passed (10 new: 5 representation-service, 5 commerce-orchestrator); uv run ruff check . clean; uv run black --check . clean (51 files); uv run mypy libs/acip-common/src services strict clean (41 files); docker compose config valid.

TWO NEW SERVICES (both uv workspace members, container PORT 8000, uvicorn 0.0.0.0:8000, non-root uid 10001 python:3.11-slim via `uv sync --frozen --no-dev --package <name>`, GET /healthz -> {"status":"ok"}, GET /readyz -> {"status":"ready"}). Pinned deps: fastapi==0.115.6, uvicorn[standard]==0.34.0, httpx==0.28.1; representation-service adds neo4j==5.27.0 + redis==5.2.1; commerce-orchestrator adds langgraph==0.2.60 + redis==5.2.1 + psycopg[binary]==3.2.3.

WORKSPACE WIRING: removed representation-service + commerce-orchestrator from root pyproject [tool.uv.workspace].exclude (8 Phase-3 dirs remain). Added both to [tool.uv.sources] { workspace = true } AND to [dependency-groups].dev so a plain `uv sync` installs them and the gate resolves imports. No new mypy overrides needed (langgraph ships py.typed; nodes take (state, config) so the single-arg stub overload is satisfied with a local cast in build_graph).

=== representation-service (POST /v1/representation) ===
req  {transaction_id:str, amount:float, currency:str, method_type:MethodType('card'|'upi'|'netbanking'|'wallet'|'cod'), merchant_id:str, customer_id:str, txn_geo?:str|null, device_fingerprint?:str|null, trace_id?:str|null}
resp = acip_common.schemas.SharedRepresentation {representation_version:int (from Settings.representation_version), transaction_id, built_at:datetime, transaction:TransactionCore, features:dict[str,float] (all 7 FEATURE_COLUMNS via build_feature_row), graph_signals:dict[str,float], method_history:dict[method->MethodHistoryEntry], candidate_routes:[CandidateRoute]}
stores.py: GraphStore (Neo4j) hydrates ring_size (Device-[:LINKED_TO]->Customer distinct count = seed.py edge direction; the docs 'FROM_DEVICE' device-sharing pattern), customer_txn_count_30d + customer_chargeback_count (Customer props), per-method USED_METHOD_TYPE successes/failures, candidate Processor routes; HotStore (Redis) reads velocity:1h:<customer_id>. BOTH degradation-tolerant: fetch() returns (signals, degraded) and never raises; drivers/clients open lazily (import needs no store). Built representation cached in Redis at key representation:<transaction_id> (best-effort). /readyz always 'ready' (store absence tolerated = up-but-degraded). SPARSE-GRAPH FALLBACK: empty/unreachable stores -> zeros + single default route CandidateRoute(processor='processor_default', success_rate=0.9); logged 'representation built in degraded mode'. NOTE: customer_mean/customer_std/method_first_seen_days are not kept online so default 0.0 (zscore guards zero-std -> 0.0; method age 0.0) - a later FEAT can wire baselines without changing the contract.

=== commerce-orchestrator (POST /internal/evaluate) === the sync trigger checkout-api (FEAT-004) calls
req  {transaction_id?:str|null (server mints txn_<hex16> if absent), trace_id?:str|null (server mints uuid4 if absent), amount:float, currency:str, method_type:MethodType, merchant_id:str, customer_id:str, txn_geo?:str|null, device_fingerprint?:str|null}
resp = acip_common.schemas.DecisionRenderedPayload {decision:DecisionHint('APPROVE'|'CHALLENGE'|'DECLINE'|'ROUTE'), composite_score:float, strategy:str('weighted_veto'), route:str|null, route_alternatives:[str], recommended_method:str|null, contributing_verdicts:[AgentName], explanation:str, degraded_agents:[AgentName]}  (HTTP 200). This IS the decision-engine payload passed straight through.
GRAPH (LangGraph StateGraph, compiled with MemorySaver): START -> build_representation -> fan_out -> collect_verdicts -(conditional route_after_collect)-> {all_received:'decide' | deadline:'decide_partial'} -> execute -> finalize -> END. build_representation calls representation-service; fan_out publishes a txn.evaluate.requested EventEnvelope (TxnEvaluateRequestedPayload: representation + expected_agents=all 6 AgentName + deadline_ms=Settings.decision_deadline_ms) to topic txn.evaluate; collect_verdicts consumes topic agent.verdicts via EventConsumer(group 'commerce-orchestrator-verdicts'), filters by transaction_id + event_type AGENT_VERDICT_PRODUCED, accumulates until all 6 arrive OR DECISION_DEADLINE_MS elapses; decide/decide_partial POST decision-engine /v1/decide with the collected (possibly empty) verdict map keyed by AgentName.value + representation.candidate_routes; execute POSTs payment-processor-sim /v1/charge ONLY on APPROVE/ROUTE (else short-circuits; a 503/charge error is caught and recorded as a DECLINED processor_result so finalize still runs); finalize publishes the terminal txn.executed/declined/challenged EventEnvelope (TxnTerminalPayload) to topic txn.lifecycle and persists via persistence.py.
PHASE 2 NO-AGENTS GUARANTEE (unit-tested, mocked deps): with zero agents collect_verdicts hits the deadline with 0 verdicts, route_after_collect returns 'decide_partial', decision-engine applies MISSING_RISK_FRAUD_POLICY (default CHALLENGE) and a decision IS produced. Logged exactly: 'no verdicts received, deadline elapsed, applying missing-verdict policy'. Test test_zero_verdict_deadline_reaches_decide_partial_decision asserts decide called once with {} and a decision returned; test_all_verdicts_before_deadline_takes_decide_path_and_charges covers the all_received->decide path.
DEPS INJECTION: node fns take (state, config); live deps (ServiceClients, EventProducer, EventConsumer, Settings, persist callable) are passed via config['configurable']['deps'], NOT the graph state, so MemorySaver only serializes plain-data channels (otherwise msgpack fails on httpx/Kafka clients). State channels: transaction_id, trace_id, amount, currency, method_type, merchant_id, customer_id, txn_geo, device_fingerprint, representation, verdicts, deadline_reached, decision, processor_result.
CHECKPOINT CHOICE (justified in graph.py docstring): MemorySaver drives LangGraph superstep checkpointing (stable public interface); durable cross-process crash-resume is a compact JSON state snapshot written to Redis at key orchestrator:checkpoint:<transaction_id> via RedisStateSnapshotStore (best-effort, degrades with Redis down). Avoided pinning a churny langgraph-checkpoint-redis package.
clients.py: httpx sync wrappers for representation-service, decision-engine, payment-processor-sim; timeout = max(2.0, decision_deadline_ms/1000 + 2.0); trace_id propagated in every request body.

=== POSTGRES ROWS finalize WRITES (checkout-api FEAT-004 reads these; shapes match scripts/seed.py exactly) === persistence.persist_decision(postgres_dsn, representation, decision, verdicts) does idempotent upserts (ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE), best-effort (DB down -> logs + returns False, path still completes):
  transactions: INSERT (id=transaction_id PK, customer_id=representation.transaction.customer_id, amount=representation.transaction.amount, status, decision=decision.decision.value) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE. status mapped from decision via status_for_decision(): APPROVE/ROUTE->'EXECUTED', CHALLENGE->'CHALLENGED', DECLINE->'DECLINED'.
  decisions: INSERT (transaction_id PK, decision=decision.decision.value, composite_score=decision.composite_score, strategy=decision.strategy) ON CONFLICT (transaction_id) DO UPDATE.
  agent_verdicts: one row per collected verdict INSERT (transaction_id, agent=AgentName.value, score=verdict.score, decision_hint=verdict.decision_hint.value) ON CONFLICT (transaction_id, agent) DO UPDATE. In the Phase-2 no-agents path zero agent_verdicts rows are written (empty verdict set).
Terminal lifecycle event -> topic txn.lifecycle: event_type EventType.TXN_EXECUTED (APPROVE/ROUTE) | TXN_CHALLENGED (CHALLENGE) | TXN_DECLINED (DECLINE); payload TxnTerminalPayload {decision, route, processor_result, composite_score, decided_at}.

NOTE: compose + Makefile wiring of these two services is NOT done here (left to FEAT-004 which owns compose/checkout-api per context.json); Dockerfiles are provided and build-ready. Verified against FEAT-002 contracts: decision-engine /v1/decide verdict map keyed by AgentName.value, candidate_routes passed through; payment-processor-sim 503 handled as failover-able decline.
